Files of the prefectural land prices

Source: R/prefectural-land-price-get.R
prefectural_land_price_files.Rd

prefectural_land_price_files() lists the file of each year of prefectural_land_price_get(), as land_price_files() does for 地価公示. It is used by the bundled pipeline.

Usage

prefectural_land_price_files()

Value

A tibble with one row per year: year, file_name, the columns city_code, use_code, site_number, and price, epsg, n_points, and the url of the file.

Examples

prefectural_land_price_files()
#> # A tibble: 21 × 9
#>     year file_name     city_code use_code site_number price  epsg n_points url  
#>    <int> <chr>         <chr>     <chr>    <chr>       <chr> <int>    <int> <chr>
